label: A repeated request returns the first answer again
code:
first = api.post("/orders", json=ORDER, headers={"Idempotency-Key": "k-replay"})
again = api.post("/orders", json=ORDER, headers={"Idempotency-Key": "k-replay"})
assert first.status_code == 201, f"first request -> {first.status_code}"
assert again.status_code == first.status_code and again.json() == first.json(), f"replay -> {again.status_code} {again.json()}"
assert again.headers.get("Idempotent-Replayed") == "true", "replay is not marked Idempotent-Replayed"

label: The same key with another body is refused
code:
api.post("/orders", json=ORDER, headers={"Idempotency-Key": "k-reused"})
other = dict(ORDER, items=[{"dish": "pho-bo", "qty": 1}])
response = api.post("/orders", json=other, headers={"Idempotency-Key": "k-reused"})
assert response.status_code == 422, f"reused key with another body -> {response.status_code}"

label: A duplicate while the first is in progress waits
code:
handle = api.start("/orders", json=ORDER, headers={"Idempotency-Key": "k-flight"})
duplicate = api.post("/orders", json=ORDER, headers={"Idempotency-Key": "k-flight"})
first = api.finish(handle)
assert duplicate.status_code == 409, f"duplicate during processing -> {duplicate.status_code}"
assert first.status_code == 201, f"first request -> {first.status_code}"

label: A retry after a timeout creates no second order
code:
try:
    api.post("/orders", json=ORDER, headers={"Idempotency-Key": "k-lost"}, lose_response=True)
except TimeoutError:
    pass
retry = api.post("/orders", json=ORDER, headers={"Idempotency-Key": "k-lost"})
orders = api.get(f"/orders?customer_id={ORDER['customer_id']}").json()
assert retry.status_code == 201 and len(orders) == 1, f"retry -> {retry.status_code}, {len(orders)} orders"
assert retry.json()["id"] == orders[0]["id"], "retry returned another order"
